messages:
Mike (AE): Quick sync — AcmeHealth POC progressing, legal asked for MSA/DPA redlines. Need pricing confirmation and final signing path. Can we get legal + procurement eyes?
Sara (Sales Ops): Pinged @Julia and @Amelia. Order form attached in thread below (snippet). Customer expects dedicated pool + 100k tokens/month, start date 2026-04-01.
Tom (SE): Verified performance on their test prompts — 95th percentile latency within SLA on dedicated. No code changes needed.
Mike (AE): Pricing question from buyer: they want committed rate for first 6 months with a 20% discount vs list. Is that approved? Also PO vs e-sign preference?
Amelia (Procurement): AcmeHealth prefers PO + e-sign. Finance requires invoice on PO receipt. They can do Net30. We need exact invoice address and PO number to route.
Julia (Legal): Skimmed the redlines — main asks: (1) increase liability cap from $1M to $5M; (2) EU data residency clause for EU tenants; (3) DPA requires subprocessors list and 30-day notice for changes.
Mike (AE): They pushed on liability cap during negotiation. Is a $5M cap an absolute blocker?
Julia (Legal): We usually hold to $1M for self-serve/standard, but for Dedicated/Enterprise we can consider $3M with signoff. $5M needs exec legal + insurance confirmation. What tier is this?
Mike (AE): This will be Dedicated with SLA and a committed monthly spend ~ $12k/mo. Looking to land asap — they asked for a copyable clause.
Tom (SE): One technical note: SLA p99 latency is tied to dedicated pool config. We need the order form to call out the instance size so ops can provision.
Sara (Sales Ops): Order form snippet for signature (please check):
```
Product: Redwood Dedicated - 1x A100-equivalent pool
Term: 12 months (auto renew)
Committed Tokens: 100,000/month
Unit Price: $0.00012/token (net of 20% discount applied for Q1)
Onboarding credit: One-time $5,000 credit
Billing: Invoice on receipt of PO, Net30
```
Mike (AE): Can legal mark if that pricing language is ok and whether the discount needs to be limited to first 6 months in contract language?
Julia (Legal): Pricing is commercial; legal just needs the term spelled out. We should include "Promotional discount applies to first 6 months only" if that's what sales wants. Also need to approve the auto-renew language.
Amelia (Procurement): For PO routing: send DocuSign to three signers — (1) Acme procurement, (2) Acme legal, (3) our sales lead. After DocuSign, they will issue the PO. Finance requires the DocuSign to include the exact billing address and tax ID.
Mike (AE): Good — suggested DocuSign flow below. Can Sales Ops create envelope?
Sara (Sales Ops): Yes, I can. Suggested envelope routing: Mike -> Acme Procurement (procure@acmehealth.com) -> Acme Legal (legal@acmehealth.com) -> Finance Ops (finance@redwood.com). Will include order form PDF + MSA redline as attachment.
Julia (Legal): I'll post a redline within 24h. Quick ask: can we add a short clause giving Redwood 60 days' notice to update subprocessor list instead of 30? Client asked for 30-day. We prefer 60.
Mike (AE): Client pushing for 30. Tradeoff? 60 vs 30 seems reasonable to move faster.
Julia (Legal): If procurement can accept 60, we retain that. If they insist on 30, need head of legal approval.
Amelia (Procurement): Acme says procurement policy requires 30-day notice. They may accept 45 as compromise.
Tom (SE): Noted — subprocessor notice timing doesn't affect runtime itself, just compliance.
Finance Bot: Reminder: if PO value > $100k/year, finance requires revenue recognition checklist and ARs lead to pre-approve terms. Current projection ~ $144k/year.
Mike (AE): Good catch. Will flag to CRO if we need to escalate for >$100k approvals.
Sara (Sales Ops): Action items: Julia to post redline (24h), Sara to prep DocuSign envelope (today), Amelia to confirm invoice address and PO contact (EOD), Mike to confirm discount term language with customer.
Julia (Legal): Redline incoming — will try to keep changes minimal: liability cap -> propose $3M, subprocessor notice -> 45 days compromise language, DPA subprocessors list to be provided within 10 days of signature.
Amelia (Procurement): Once redline is acceptable, we'll sign via DocuSign and issue PO. Please include PO line for "Dedicated runtime" and separate line for "Onboarding services".
Mike (AE): Thanks team. I'll update the buyer with proposed compromises and ask for PO intent. If they push hard on $5M, I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
Sara (Sales Ops): Noted. I'll queue the envelope and ping when ready.
